newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat-High protein sales pick up.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat-High protein sales pick up.

text.p: Dark Northern Spring wheat cash bids were weak on Thursday, in line with lower MGE futures, and dealers noted a pickup in high protein wheat movement as mill bids firmed.
"We've brought these 15 percent premiums up and we're starting to see (wheat) coming out," a Minnesota dealer said.
But farmer selling of lower protein levels remained slack as farmers opted for inexpensive storage space rather than selling grain, several dealers said.
In Montana, selling picked up slightly as farmers raised money to pay a November 1 property tax, one dealer said.
"There is a little bit of selling but it's more of a tax thing," he said.
In other Montana locations, basis levels dropped as buyers filled immediate needs and backed out of the market.
"The demand was there. It got booked. Now it's time to back away," a dealer said, referring to the drop in basis.
Snow in parts of Washington slowed movement, but dealers noted the moisture was beneficial for developing crops.
